kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أقترب (form VIII)
# أَقْتَرِبُ (ʔaqtaribu) /ʔaq.ta.ri.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَرَبَ (iqtaraba)
# أَقْتَرِبَ (ʔaqtariba) /ʔaq.ta.ri.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَرَبَ (iqtaraba)
# أَقْتَرِبْ (ʔaqtarib) /ʔaq.ta.rib/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِقْتَرَبَ (iqtaraba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
